rationale: The exact proposal binds the authored candidate and both accepted initial semantic reviews. All 49 accepted pair/result triples occur exactly once across 27 boards, preserve candidate and edge identities, add no output to an existing core pair and retain reviewed core concepts. All 27 seeds, targets, categories, complete recipe cores and routes agree with the candidate; the saved native projection audit and bounded MinimumPlan proof preserve par. Independently checked compact core/entry hashes, 294 board-local node snapshots and 351 edge snapshots agree with current KG provenance. The required derived/quick pins, current proposal source bindings, all nine audit source bindings and 135 runtime-provenance hashes agree with current files. Acceptance covers structural/projection and bounded-plan evidence; the counters named replayed do not establish game-session actions or HTTP replay.
